core_purpose: A standardized scaffold/meta-repository for bootstrapping new open-source projects in the Scramjet ecosystem. It ships community-health files, AI assistant context (Cursor/Copilot), Biome lint+format, Husky+commitlint conventional-commits enforcement, Dependabot, stale-bot, Release Please automation, and pkg.pr.new preview publishing — but contains no application source code.

architecture.backend: None (target runtime documented as Cloudflare Workers/Pages)

main_features.name: Community health files (LICENSE, CoC, Contributing, Security, PR/Issue templates, CODEOWNERS)

technical_debt: CI workflow runs `npm run build` but no `build` script is defined in package.json — CI will fail on every push/PR. The `lint` script invokes `eslint .` but ESLint is not installed as a dependency (only Biome and Prettier are present), so `npm run check` will fail. CONTRIBUTING.md tells contributors to run `npm test` but no test script or test runner exists. Both Prettier (lint-staged) and Biome (format/lint) are configured, creating tooling overlap and potential conflicts. No `src/` directory or actual application code — the repo's stated `Cloudflare-native` orientation is aspirational, enforced only via AI rules. `pnpm-lock.yaml` is committed and `packageManager` is pnpm@9, but CI uses `npm ci` with npm cache — package manager mismatch. `.gitignore` is only 14 bytes (likely incomplete). No CHANGELOG.md yet despite Release Please configuration. CODEOWNERS references `@scramjetio/*` teams that may not exist on the actual GitHub org.
active_roadmap: No open GitHub issues — roadmap is implicit. Highest-priority implied work: fix CI by adding a `build` script (or removing the build step), reconcile npm-vs-pnpm in CI, install ESLint or drop it from the `lint` script, and add a real test runner so `npm test` referenced in CONTRIBUTING.md works.
